Use case: stylized-concept. Make a finished bunker floor illustration for a dark olive and charcoal grand-strategy game management UI. Reference image is ONLY the approved art style and full SIDE ELEVATION CUTAWAY composition. Output ONE ultra-wide landscape image, 3:1 aspect ratio (1536 by 512). A complete single long low floor viewed from FAR BACK, straight-on orthographic side elevation. Fit BOTH end walls and the complete ceiling and bottom slab into frame, with small even 4 percent margins; the entire self-contained structure occupies 90 percent width and 78 percent height. No closeup, no perspective corridor, no crop. Recompose the whole structure for the wide canvas; no black letterbox borders. Polished restrained painted 2D architectural game art, clear readable small silhouettes, reduced microtexture, purposeful large equipment shapes. Match grey concrete, aged olive metal, muted copper, warm ivory work lights; use moderate neutral-warm ambient fill so the whole interior is legible at thumbnail size, softly lit walls and equipment, no crushed shadows, no pitch-black rooms, no dramatic chiaroscuro, no harsh bright bloom, no neon blue. Surrounding rock is flat subdued charcoal suited to a dark game panel. Functional gritty early-industrial post-imperial engineering, serious tone, no fantasy. Tiny people only as scale cues. No text, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no interface, no watermark. ONE floor only.
FLOOR 1 - Access and shelter. Left: thick sealed blast door, compact guard checkpoint with lockers, small analogue security desk, guarded access bay. Right: orderly shelter bunks, benches, water canisters, emergency stores. Clear structural bays, safe warm practical lighting and neutral fill. Keep recognizable separate security and living functions.
